state_analysis: The analysis_report.txt file has been created successfully. Now I need to create the optimized_logrotate.conf and rotation_summary.csv files.
explanation: Let me create the optimized logrotate configuration file with proper rotation schedules, compression, and retention policies for all log files.

commands.keystrokes:
cat > /app/optimized_logrotate.conf << 'EOF'
# Optimized Logrotate Configuration
# Generated by Log Rotation Analyzer
# Addresses: disk space issues, inconsistent rotation, missing compression

# Access Log - High growth rate (45.7 MB/day), medium importance
# Changed from monthly to daily rotation
/var/log/samples/access.log {
    daily
    rotate 14
    compress
    compresscmd /bin/gzip
    compressext .gz
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    maxsize 100M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        /usr/bin/systemctl reload nginx > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
    endscript
}

# Application Log - High importance, 12.5 MB/day growth
# Changed from weekly to daily rotation
/var/log/samples/app.log {
    daily
    rotate 30
    compress
    compresscmd /bin/gzip
    compressext .gz
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    maxsize 100M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
}

# Error Log - Critical importance, was missing rotation config
# New configuration with 60-day retention for compliance
/var/log/samples/error.log {
    daily
    rotate 60
    compress
    compresscmd /bin/gzip
    compressext .gz
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    maxsize 50M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
}

# Debug Log - Low importance, was missing rotation config
# Short retention (7 days) to minimize disk usage
/var/log/samples/debug.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    compresscmd /bin/gzip
    compressext .gz
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    maxsize 50M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
}

# System Log - Already well configured, minor optimizations
# Keeping weekly rotation due to low growth rate (2.1 MB/day)
/var/log/samples/system.log {
    weekly
    rotate 30
    compress
    compresscmd /bin/gzip
    compressext .gz
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 root adm
    maxsize 100M
    dateext
    dateformat -%Y%m%d
}
EOF
echo 'Logrotate config created'
